title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn how to look for a job.
(2) learn how to analyze their strengths and weaknesses.
(3) learn how to analyze industry trends.
advice: In this course, students will prepare to look for a job. Practicing self-analysis and analyzing industry trends will be executed.
requiredKnowledge: Summarize your life as a student and thinking deeply about your future career in advance to start looking for a job in the spring.

activityGoals.body: Ability to think about the relationship between future life and career planning.
Ability to logically explain their own career planning.
